units: litres; 1 in-game day = 24 h from Sky Director

sources.rule: Caldera-fed hot spring; always clean; primary drink source. Heat zone nearby doubles thirst drain so spring placement matters.
Condensed vent steam plus rain catch; tops up cistern when spring demand spikes after forge shift.
Ash-slope well; must boil/filter before drinking; livestock quench troughs accept it after Prop_WaterBoiler_Copper pass.
Ash-field rain catch; clean when settled 1 min.
Basalt-coast solar/forge still; primary salt source for cooking + backup clean water on no-rain days.
Forge quench tub doubles as livestock drink after cool-down; tag drinkable when filled with spring/still water. Magma-side quench (Forge Temper magma path) is NOT drinkable until cooled and diluted.
Ash ranch pens drink here; fed from HotSpring_Clean or quenched boiler water.

thirst.player: thirst 0..100, +4/h base, x2 in caldera heat zone; drink 1 L clean = -35; dirty = -20 + 30% sick; salt = +10 thirst. >80 halves stamina; 100 = 1 hp/10s
thirst.animals: unwatered 1 day: no eggs/milk/wool/honey; 3 days: animal leaves (cozy rule never dies off-island)
thirst.herbs: unwatered herbs pause growth; Steamreed and Boilbalm grow only if a vent or spring watered them that day

balance: Hot spring alone (~1920 L/day) covers player + full ranch + herb beds. Rain/vent/still cover forge-shift quench spikes and drought. Island never dies of thirst; magma heat makes water the real currency.
items: Prop_WaterCanteen_Copper (5 L), Prop_WaterBucket_Clay (3 L), Prop_WaterBarrel_Iron (40 L), Prop_WaterCistern_Clay (200 L)
